inviteForm.undelivered: The invitation for {email} exists, but this server did not send the email. Once mail is configured, revoke it and invite them again.

members.title: Members
members.notSentMessage: The earlier link to {email} no longer works and the new email could not be sent. Press Resend again.
members.sentMessage: A new invitation was sent to {email}.
members.resendFailed: {reason}. The previous link may no longer work, so press Resend again.

personal.title: Your personal workspace
personal.description: A personal workspace has a single owner, so there is nobody to invite here. To work with other people, create a team workspace: you become its owner and can invite them by email.

hidden.billingTitle: Members are not visible to your role
hidden.billingBody: The Billing role covers billing only: it cannot list members or change roles. Ask an Owner or Admin if you need access.
hidden.noRoleBody: No workspace role was found for this session. Sign in again, or ask an Owner or Admin for access.

members.readOnly: You can see who is in this workspace, but only an Owner or Admin can change roles, remove members or invite people.

removeDialog.leaveMessage: You will lose access to {name} until someone invites you again.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke invitation?
revokeDialog.message: The link sent to {email} will stop working.

settings.createdSwitchFailed: {name} was created, but switching to it failed: {reason}
settings.createdSwitchManual: {name} was created; switch to it from the workspace menu.
settings.preferenceSaved: Media work in {name} is now set to "{label}".
settings.preferenceFailed: Could not change where this workspace runs its work
settings.title: Workspace settings
settings.personalNote: This is your personal workspace. It is always shown as “Personal”, has a single owner, and its members and invitations are not managed from here. Create a team workspace to work with other people.
settings.nameDescription: Shown in the workspace menu and to every member.
settings.ownerOrAdminRename: Only an Owner or Admin can rename this workspace.

compute.title: Where your work runs
compute.readOnly: This workspace is set to “{label}”. Only an Owner or Admin can change it.

delete.title: Delete workspace
delete.body: Deleting removes the workspace and everyone's access to it. Projects are not deleted. This cannot be undone from the UI.
delete.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can delete it.

settings.readOnlyAdmin: Your role in this workspace is read-only.
settings.readOnlyRole: You are signed in as {role} of this workspace, so its settings are read-only for you.

deleteDialog.title: Delete workspace?
deleteDialog.message: {name} and all of its members will be removed. Projects are not deleted.

providers.title: Providers
providers.noRoleBody: No workspace role was found for this session. Sign in again, or ask an Owner or Admin for access.
providers.managedTitle: Your providers are managed by an Owner or Admin
providers.managedBody: You can still choose which provider a workflow step uses: the step editor offers every provider this workspace can use. Adding or changing one is limited to Owners and Admins{role, select, Billing {, and the Billing role has no provider access at all.} other {.}}
providers.managedBodyShort: Adding or changing a workspace provider is limited to Owners and Admins{role, select, Billing {, and the Billing role has no provider access at all.} other {.}}
providers.loadFailedFallback: Please try again in a moment.
providers.emptyDescription: Your workspace uses ReelBolt's own providers until you add one here. A provider of your own must be a public endpoint and is charged to your workspace.
providers.deleteMessage: Delete {name} and every model under it? Steps and agents still pointing at one of its models fall back to the default.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: API keys let other software act as this workspace. Each key is its own member, so it keeps working if you leave.
apiKeys.loadFailedBody: Please try again in a moment.
apiKeys.notAvailableBody: This deployment has the public API turned off.
apiKeys.emptyDescription: Create a key to call the API from a script, a CI job or another app.

hidden.memberTitle: Only an Owner or Admin can manage API keys
hidden.memberBody: API keys act for the whole workspace, so only an Owner or Admin can create, change or revoke one.
hidden.billingTitle: API keys are not visible to your role
hidden.billingBody: The Billing role covers billing only: it cannot list or manage API keys. Ask an Owner or Admin if you need access.
hidden.noRoleBody: No workspace role was found for this session. Sign in again, or ask an Owner or Admin for access.

values.expiresInDays: Expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
values.capsNotEnforced: Usage caps apply only when billing is on.

scope.projectsReadDescription: Read project names, files and settings.
scope.projectsWriteDescription: Create projects and change their name, files and settings.
scope.filesReadDescription: List and download files in projects this key can see.
scope.filesWriteDescription: Upload files and change their metadata.
scope.workflowsReadDescription: Read workflows and their step configuration.
scope.workflowsWriteDescription: Create workflows and change their steps.
scope.runsReadDescription: Read run history, status and outputs.
scope.runsExecuteDescription: Start a workflow and spend this workspace's credits.
scope.outputsReadDescription: List and download finished videos and other outputs.
scope.mediaEgressDescription: Lets this key allow sending your media to AI services for a run it starts (inputs.allowMediaEgress). Off unless you tick it.

create.title: New API key
create.expiryTooFar: Pick a date within one year from today.
create.expiryTooSoon: Pick a date at least one hour from now.
create.noExpiryWarning: This key will never expire. If it leaks, it works until you revoke it.
create.capsDescription: Stop the key after it spends this many credits in a window. Leave empty for no cap.
create.footer: This key acts as its own member of the workspace, not as you. It keeps working if you leave.
create.planHint: On the Trial plan you can create keys and read through the API (list apps, see inputs, estimate cost). Running apps and uploading files need a paid plan.
create.planBody: API keys are part of the paid plans. Upgrade this workspace to create one.
create.limit: This workspace has reached its API key limit. Revoke a key you no longer use, then try again.

secret.title: Your new API key
secret.body: This is the only time you will see the secret. Copy it now and store it somewhere safe.
secret.label: Secret
secret.warning: You won't see this key again. Do not put it in a public repository or a log.

edit.title: Edit API key
edit.capsDescription: Stop the key after it spends this many credits in a window. Leave empty for no cap.

audit.title: Activity for {name}
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the activity. Try again.

revoke.title: Revoke API key?
revoke.message: "{name}" will stop working at once. Every integration using it fails until it is replaced.

notifications.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the key. It is still active.

webhooks.description: A webhook sends a signed message to your server when a run finishes or a request is refused.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Add an HTTPS endpoint to be told when runs succeed, fail or are cancelled.

status.disabledAuto: Disabled after 72 hours without a successful delivery
status.disabledApiKeyRevoked: Disabled because its API key was revoked

form.urlHelp: Must be a public https address.
form.limit: This workspace already has the maximum of 10 endpoints.
form.saveFailed: The endpoint could not be saved.

events.runSucceededHelp: A run finished and its outputs are ready.
events.runFailedHelp: A run stopped with an error.
events.runCancelledHelp: A run was cancelled before it finished.
events.runStepCompletedHelp: Each step of a run finished. Can be frequent.
events.runRequestStartedHelp: A run requested through the API was accepted and started.
events.runRequestRefusedHelp: A run requested through the API was refused, for example for lack of credits.

secret.title: Your webhook signing secret
secret.body: Use this secret to verify the signature of every delivery we send to your endpoint.
secret.rotatedBody: Deliveries are now signed with this secret. The old secret keeps signing for 24 hours, so you can switch over without a gap.
secret.warning: You won't see this secret again. Do not put it in a public repository or a log.

rotate.title: Rotate signing secret?
rotate.message: A new secret is created for {url}. The old one keeps signing for 24 hours.

notify.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.

capGuard.dailyHelp: New keys stop at {default} credits a day unless you choose otherwise.
capGuard.raiseConsequence: A higher daily limit lets this key spend more credits each day. If it is ever misused, it can use up your credits faster.
capGuard.removeConsequence: With no daily limit, this key can spend your credits without stopping for the day. If it is ever misused, it can use up your credits fast.
capGuard.confirmLabel: I understand and want to do this
capGuard.confirmNeeded: Tick the box to confirm the daily limit change.
capGuard.confirmRequired: Please confirm the daily limit change, then try again.
capGuard.dailyRequired: Enter a daily limit, or choose no daily limit.
capGuard.legacyWarning: This key has no daily limit. Set one so a mistake cannot use up your credits.
capGuard.trialNotice: Your workspace can read through the API but cannot run apps or upload files until you upgrade.
capGuard.readOnlyPlan: Your plan can read through the API but cannot run apps or upload files. Upgrade to do that.
